settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: Public host name where Huginn is reachable. It must resolve to this server.
settings.timezone_not_valid: Unknown time zone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
settings.proxy_hint_desc: When Huginn runs on a worker node and is published through a gateway node, the gateway's custom route must point to https://<worker-VPN-address> with "Skip certificate verification" enabled. On this node keep Let's Encrypt and HTTP to HTTPS redirection switched off. Otherwise X-Forwarded-Proto is downgraded to http and the login fails with "The change you wanted was rejected".
settings.email_help: Preferred when set. Leave the SMTP server empty to use the cluster smarthost instead.
settings.smtp_ssl_verify_help: Disable for internal relays (e.g. the cluster smarthost) whose certificate is not valid for their address.
settings.features_help: Optional Huginn capabilities that are switched off by default. Changing either one restarts Huginn briefly.
settings.enable_insecure_agents_help: Unlocks the ShellCommandAgent and LocalFileAgent, which can run arbitrary shell commands and read or write files on the server. Security risk: only enable this on a trusted, single-tenant instance whose users you fully trust.
settings.enable_second_precision_schedule_help: Allows second-level fields in the SchedulerAgent cron expression. By default schedules run with minute precision.
settings.registration_help: Control who can create an account on this Huginn instance.
settings.invitation_code_helper: Required to register. A random code is generated on install; share it only with people who should be allowed to sign up. Leave empty to keep the current code.
settings.require_confirmed_email_help: New users must confirm their email address before they can log in. Needs a working mail relay (see Email above).
settings.ai_help: Global fallback credentials for the built-in OpenAI agents (LLM, image, speech, video). Can also be set per agent.
settings.openai_base_url_helper: Leave empty for OpenAI. Point at a compatible endpoint, e.g. http://host:11434/v1 for Ollama.
settings.admin_credentials_desc: User "{user}" with password "{password}". Change it right after the first login.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This host name is already used by another instance.
settings.secret_is_set: A value is stored — leave blank to keep it.
settings.admin_credentials_hidden: User "{user}". The initial password is only valid until it is changed in Huginn.
settings.worker_help: Huginn runs agents in background jobs. If the database stalls (e.g. heavy disk load during a backup), a job can hit the time limit and leave the worker stuck: web UI and webhooks keep working, but no agent runs any more.
settings.health_catching_up: Worker catching up after a restart
settings.health_numbers: Overdue for more than {minutes} min: {backlog} jobs. Queued: {queued}, failed: {failed}.
settings.stale_agents: Scheduled agents without a run for more than 26 hours:
settings.delayed_job_max_runtime_helper: An agent run taking longer is aborted. Huginn's default of 2 minutes is too short for large fetches and slow disks.
settings.delayed_job_workers_helper: Agents running in parallel; each worker needs about 300 MB RAM.
settings.healthcheck_mode: Automatic restart of a stuck worker
settings.healthcheck_mode_restart: Restart; the backlog is processed afterwards (alarms of the outage may follow)
settings.healthcheck_mode_quiet: Restart quietly; drop the backlog, mail agents skip the events of the outage
settings.healthcheck_backlog: Restart from this many overdue jobs
settings.healthcheck_mail_to_helper: Gets a mail through the cluster smarthost after an automatic restart.
settings.value_out_of_range: Value out of the allowed range

agents.title: Custom agents
agents.description: Upload your own Huginn agent Ruby files. They are loaded at startup. Adding or removing an agent restarts Huginn briefly.
agents.restart_desc: The change was saved. Huginn restarts to load the agent; this takes about a minute.
agents.ruby_syntax_error: The file has a Ruby syntax error and was not installed:
agents.invalid_file_name: Invalid file name. Use letters, digits, '_' or '-' and a .rb extension.
